description: A big dog sits in the sun.
Three cats sit on a bed.
A big ball is on the court.
A big hat is on the table.
Many sweet oranges are in a pile.
A green watermelon has dark lines.
A sad cat is in a white towel.
A man holds a board on the sand.
A small yellow ball is on the floor.
A big wheel is up in the sky.
A wet orange cat is wrapped tightly in a soft white towel.
A round watermelon has dark green stripes on its smooth skin.
Many people sit around a table for a meeting in a bright office.
Bright sailboats with large yellow and blue sails move on the water.
A hot cup of black coffee sits on a dark orange table.
A big white Ferris wheel stands tall against a clear blue sky.
Pink flowers make pretty shapes as they float on the green water.

Dark purple paint and pink paint are brushed across a white paper.
